svg.text: Managed PostgreSQL with auth, API and storage
Rules run inside the database, so they hold
even if the client is bypassed.
direct from the browser: maps, weather, CAPTCHA
Reporting a problem, step by step
Citizen or guest fills in the report in the app
Signs in, or a guest session is created
Photos and video upload to storage
Report is inserted through the REST API
Triggers check access, duplicates, limits and priority
AI suggestions: auto-fill, duplicate check, routing
Followers are notified by email and web push
